text:
lina_support: FYI — ACME attempted to switch billing to Net 30 and the charge for INV-2026-332 failed. Customer sees "card declined" and support portal shows PO mismatch.

billing-bot: Charge failed: invoice INV-2026-332, amount $12,345.00 USD — reason: card_declined (decline_code: generic_decline), txn=txn_7F3a9

sarah_csm: Customer says they switched to Net 30 yesterday. They uploaded PO-889 but invoice metadata still references PO-777. They're blocked from using the service until payment is applied. :frowning:

eli_engineer: Can you paste the payment gateway response and the invoice metadata? Need to confirm whether our webhook matched the PO field or if it was a customer-side mismatch.

lina_support: Gateway payload:
```
{"invoice":"INV-2026-332","amount":12345,"status":"failed","error":{"code":"card_declined","decline_code":"generic_decline"},"txn_id":"txn_7F3a9"}
```
Invoice custom fields:
```
{"po_number":"PO-777","terms":"Net30","customer_po":"PO-889"}
```

marcus_finance: Policy: PO must match invoice.po_number or we cannot auto-apply Net terms. If customer submits a different PO, we need either (a) updated signed PO to match invoice, (b) invoice reissued with the customer's PO number, or (c) director-level override for a temporary exception.

chris_ops: Short options for unblock:
• Accept manual wire payment now, then enroll Net 30 once PO is reconciled.
• Approve provisional credit up to $10k (requires finance sign-off + sales confirmation). If overdue beyond grace, put account on hold automatically.

lina_support: @marcus_finance can you approve provisional credit for the outstanding invoice while we get PO corrected? Customer is threatening to cut usage otherwise.

marcus_finance: I'm ok with provisional credit up to $10k for ACME (pending sales/AM confirmation). Anything above needs director sign-off. Also request Legal to confirm we can accept mismatched PO temporarily — tagging @sarah_csm to drive PO collection.

sarah_csm: I'll ping the customer now. They offered to wire $12,345 immediately to cover the invoice and then submit a corrected PO PDF. I'll attach the wire instruction and ETA when I have it.

eli_engineer: From the webhook perspective, we didn't drop the PO field — invoice created with PO-777. If finance wants the invoice reissued with PO-889 I can create a corrected invoice (will change invoice id) or we can append customer_po as a metadata note for reconciliation. Which do you prefer?

lina_support: Prefer reissue with customer's PO so accounting matches. But customer wants no delay — they can wire first.

marcus_finance: OK proceed: customer wires $12,345 -> mark invoice paid manually -> reissue invoice as INV-2026-332-R1 with PO-889 for records. Finance will post a memo linking the two invoices for audit. chris_ops, can you document the manual payment steps?

chris_ops: Steps to mark manual payment (console):
```
1) Billing → Invoices → INV-2026-332 → Mark as Paid (manual)
2) Create Credit/Receipt record: type=wire, amount=12345, ref=wire_2026_acme
3) Reissue invoice with new PO: Create invoice copy, set po_number=PO-889, send to customer
```

lina_support: @sarah_csm please confirm when wire is initiated and paste SWIFT reference. I'll apply manual payment once we have ref.

sarah_csm: Wire initiated — reference SWIFT: ACMEWIRE2026X — ETA 24-48h. Customer attached signed PO (PO-889) in reply. Uploading to ticket now.

billing-bot: Manual payment recorded by lina_support: receipt rcpt_2026_wire_001 (pending bank settlement).

marcus_finance: Noted. I'll record provisional credit policy entry for this account and mark allowable exposure=10k. After settlement, we'll close the loop and move account fully to Net 30 with invoice reissued.

lina_support: Thanks everyone. I'll update ticket and watch for settlement. If bank declines the wire or amount short, we'll revert to hold and escalate.

sarah_csm: Wire settled — bank cleared. INV-2026-332 marked paid manually and INV-2026-332-R1 created with PO-889. Confirmed Net 30 enrollment pending one month of good standing.

marcus_finance: Closing here — finance will send confirmation email and update AR records. :thumbsup:

lina_support: Resolved from support side. Adding internal note: root cause = customer PO mismatch + card on file expired; recommend adding pre-switch checklist so customers confirm PO number and payment method when converting to Net terms.

sarah_csm: I'll make that checklist and follow up with the AM to include in next onboarding flow. :white_check_mark:
